look_here_first: Feel with the eyes: low woody-based sprawling shoots with FINE VELVETY hairs. Leaves usually 3–7 pairs of pinnae. Compare flower heads (roughly 15–33 flowers) and confirm 10 stamens per flower instead of the 5 of Illinois/prairie bundleflowers.

morphology_keys.growth_flower_fruit: Perennial or subshrub 20–50 cm stems; pubescent/fine velvety hairs. Smaller leaves with 3–7 pairs of pinnae. Heads 15–33-flowered, 10 stamens; generally straight pods about 30–80 mm.
morphology_keys.distinguishing_characters: Velvety hairy shoots plus 10 stamens vs usually more numerous pinnae with only 5 stamens in D. leptolobus and illinoensis. Compare with D. acuminatus by hair and head-flower counts.
morphology_keys.shared_genus: Unarmed perennial Fabaceae with compound bipinnate leaves and small brushlike heads, often a petiolar/rachis gland, flat legume pods. Pod structure diagnostic.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Velvety hairy shoots plus 10 stamens vs usually more numerous pinnae with only 5 stamens in D. leptolobus and illinoensis. Compare with D. acuminatus by hair and head-flower counts.
